articles.title: Agentic commerce will run on crypto rails, PayPal and Google reps tell Consensus Miami
articles.snippet: Senior figures from PayPal and Google Cloud said open payment protocols, machine-readable merchant catalogs and multi-party crypto custody are needed to scale agentic commerce.

articles.title: Kash Patel Touts AI Overhaul of FBI Crime-Fighting Operations
articles.snippet: FBI Director Kash Patel said the use of AI has accelerated child exploitation investigations, threat detection, and internal operations.

articles.title: Intel Stock Hits All-Time High After Preliminary Chip Deal With Apple
articles.snippet: A preliminary Apple-Intel manufacturing agreement—backed by a White House push—sent Intel stock above $130 on Friday.
